final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), total_info AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices, COUNT(*) as num_genders FROM gender_counts), shares AS (SELECT gc.gender, gc.invoice_count, CAST(gc.invoice_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_invoices FROM total_info) as share, 1.0 / (SELECT num_genders FROM total_info) as avg_share FROM gender_counts gc) SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - avg_share as share_minus_average FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gender
